  - The owner will see Bambos at Stanford on 14–15 Oct, with dinner on Sunday 15 Oct.

  - The meetings with Arthur Andersen UK were missed again; the owner says he will be in London next in November.
  - Karla Feldman wants the Geman licence and escrow finished before she leaves on 13 Oct.
  - Anjam Ahmad proposed that Sharad Agnihotri visit Houston from 21 Oct to 16 Dec.
  - Dincerler must answer his Associate offer by 16 Oct.
